title: On-device custom-avatar pipeline (face to params, no vendor)
summary: On-device custom-avatar creation: ARKit/Vision face landmarks (+ optional short guided video) fit the coarse avatar_params ('idealized me'); the photo/video + landmarks are discarded on-device and never uploaded (no vendor); only avatar_params persists. Fully opt-in behind the biometric consent (M1-AVAT-03). SHIP-GATED on in-house counsel sign-off (SECURITY_CHECKLIST §5.5) + secondary security review (AUTH #007).
deliverables: unity/ios (on-device capture + landmark fit + params + media discard)

acceptance_tests.test: A custom avatar is fit on-device into avatar_params that validates against the schema; the photo/video and landmarks are provably discarded on-device and no media leaves the device (no network egress of media).
No face processing begins without a granted custom_avatar_biometric consent record (SECURITY_CHECKLIST §5.1).
The resulting avatar is rig-conformant by construction and moves identically well.

blocked_by: in-house counsel sign-off of the biometric consent/retention/labels (SECURITY_CHECKLIST §5.5, AUTH #016) before ship

history.event: created under AUTH #044. Security-sensitive (biometric); blocked on counsel sign-off + secondary review before ship. On-device only, no vendor.

notes: The on-device C# runtime mirrors data/schemas/avatar/validate_avatar (reference validator + forbidden-key guard). Face never leaves the device.
